notes.title: Final update
notes.content:
The final update for Welcome To... Chichester 2 is here, and contains the following :

[list]
[*] Background graphics have now changed (and look great)
[*] Title sequence and end credits have been updated accordingly
[*] New intro sequence when starting a new game
[*] Story has been extended slightly and a new outro added (to tie into WTC 3)
[*] Spelling and various other mistakes have been fixed
[*] A few special effects added
[*] Two new Steam achievements added, and Internal awards as well
[*] Simple music player
[*] Replay from any of the six chapters (once you've reached them)
[*] Background viewer (once the game has been completed)
[*] One section of the story is now only available once the game has been completed once
[*] Can no longer rewind to the last choice
[/list]
